node.statement: Return to the same first inverse component: exact right unitality and the typed identity X=u_delta(X) bold-dot h_delta(X) from 1.1 give ||u_delta(X)-X||=||u bold-dot J-u bold-dot h||=||u bold-dot(J-h)||<=(1+epsilon_r)||u||||a||. Using ||u||<=sqrt(16/15) from 1.3.1, epsilon_r<=1/16 from 1.1, and 1.3.2 gives ||u_delta(X)-X||<=(17/sqrt(15))*epsilon_r<=5*epsilon_r. Applying this bound to the two S_delta inputs typed in 1.2 (whose defects are at most 3*epsilon_r) proves the two root inequalities for the single inverse component u_delta fixed in 1.1.
